predictions.title: Which month of 2026 will have the highest ICE arrest total in the data publicly available by August 26, 2026?

predictions.title: What immigration status will the Trump administration seek to require for noncitizens to be included in the 2030 US census?
predictions.reasoning: Both major GOP-state federal lawsuits against the Commerce Department—Louisiana v. Raimondo (paused through Nov 2026 while Commerce 'firms up criteria for the 2030 Census in the next few months') and Missouri's Jan 2026 complaint—explicitly contend that only U.S. citizens and those holding lawful permanent residence (excluding undocumented immigrants and temporary visa holders) may be counted.
